+
+You can also retain null results in list, object-value, and filter
+projections by setting ``preserve_nulls=True``.  By default, these
+projections omit null results.  This option applies to nested projections
+as well; filters still exclude elements whose condition is false, and
+projection bases of the wrong type still return null.  Multi-select
+expressions and ``map`` keep their existing null-handling behavior.
+
+.. code:: python
+
+    >>> options = jmespath.Options(preserve_nulls=True)
+    >>> data = {'items': [{'value': 1}, {}, {'value': None}]}
+    >>> jmespath.search('items[*].value', data, options=options)
+    [1, None, None]
+    >>> parsed = jmespath.compile('items[*].value')
+    >>> parsed.search(data, options=options)
+    [1, None, None]

@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import pytest
+
+import jmespath
+from jmespath import Options
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "expression,data,default_result,preserved_result",
+    [
+        ("rows[*].v", {"rows": [{"v": 1}, {}, {"v": None}]},
+         [1], [1, None, None]),
+        ("rows[].v", {"rows": [[{"v": 1}, {}], [{"v": None}]]},
+         [1], [1, None, None]),
+        ("rows[:].v", {"rows": [{"v": 1}, {}, {"v": None}]},
+         [1], [1, None, None]),
+        ("obj.*.v", {"obj": {"a": {"v": 1}, "b": {}, "c": {"v": None}}},
+         [1], [1, None, None]),
+        ("rows[?keep].v",
+         {"rows": [{"keep": True, "v": 1}, {"keep": True},
+                   {"keep": True, "v": None}, {"keep": False, "v": 2}]},
+         [1], [1, None, None]),
+        ("rows[*].v", {"rows": None}, None, None),
+        ("obj.*.v", {"obj": []}, None, None),
+        ("rows[?keep].v", {"rows": {}}, None, None),
+        ("rows[*].v", {"rows": []}, [], []),
+        ("rows[?keep].v", {"rows": [{"keep": False}]}, [], []),
+        ("[a, b]", {"a": 1}, [1, None], [1, None]),
+        ("{a: a, b: b}", {"a": 1},
+         {"a": 1, "b": None}, {"a": 1, "b": None}),
+        ("map(&v, rows)", {"rows": [{"v": 1}, {}]},
+         [1, None], [1, None]),
+        ("rows[*].children[*].v",
+         {"rows": [{"children": [{"v": 1}, {}]}, {}, {"children": []}]},
+         [[1], []], [[1, None], None, []]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_preserve_nulls(expression, data, default_result, preserved_result):
+    compiled = jmespath.compile(expression)
+    assert jmespath.search(expression, data) == default_result
+    assert compiled.search(data, options=Options(preserve_nulls=False)) == default_result
+    options = Options(preserve_nulls=True)
+    assert jmespath.search(expression, data, options=options) == preserved_result
+    assert compiled.search(data, options=options) == preserved_result
+    assert compiled.search(data) == default_result
